description: GET /agents/{id}/positions (§4.7 D3, DEC-2111). positions is the net filled quantity of the agent's own orders per instrument, from the FillApplied and LateFillApplied records of orders whose OrderRequestRecorded names the agent; it is not the accounting ledger's fold, which no read serves yet. account_positions is the account's, not the agent's: the latest BrokerPositionObserved per instrument, as GET /agents/{id} serves it (DEC-1020), null when the account stream is not found. as_of names the control stream and the account stream read.

Position.description: One instrument the agent's own fills left a non-zero net quantity in, in instrument order. cost_basis, risk_mark and protection are always null until the ledger fold, the risk mark, and the protection fold are served (DEC-2111 item 5): not reported, never zero.
